mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'BANNER' ) f ON f.REF_ID = b.BANNER_ID AND f.RN = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT b.BANNER_ID, b.TITLE, b.LINK_URL, b.POSITION_CD, b.START_DATE, b.END_DATE, biz.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, f.FILE_URL AS imageUrl FROM TB_BANNER b JOIN TB_BUSINESS biz ON biz.BIZ_NO = b.BIZ_NO
WHERE b.STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND b.POSITION_CD = #{positionCd} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN b.START_DATE AND b.END_DATE ORDER BY b.BANNER_ID ASC
